vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Nissan UK shop labels this generation F16 / F16E. Nissan LH/RH = the vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). Every number was read from web-search result titles and extracts of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked (shop.nissan.co.uk not reachable), so prices are as indexed by search and must be re-checked. Nissan marks most parts chassis-number (VIN) specific: verify by VIN. Several Nissan UK listings say 'Juke 2019 to 2024'; check fit on 2024-on (MY24 update) cars. Research was cut short when the shared web-search budget ran out, so coverage is partial.
